description: Analyze and manage authorized Amazon seller operations in ChatGPT and Codex.

defaultPrompt: Check my NAVINES IQ connection, then give me a live overview of my Amazon business and what needs attention first.
Investigate my listing and stock issues, then preview the most useful supported fix for my approval.
Check which buyer-contact actions are available for an order and help me prepare an appropriate message.
interface.longDescription:
Manage Amazon Seller Central by chat with NAVINES IQ Seller Insights. Explore your authorized seller data, investigate problems and turn findings into supported actions in ChatGPT or Codex.

Explore sales, orders, fees and net proceeds, listings, prices, inventory, FBA, returns, reimbursements and operational priorities. Look up product prices by ASIN, SKU, FNSKU or barcode, with a clear marketplace, currency and price source. Compare evidence, identify stock risks and listing issues, and work through practical next steps. Bring your own spreadsheets, screenshots or Amazon notices into a supported host to add context to the investigation.

With optional management access, preview and approve supported listing, price, merchant-fulfilled stock and product-attribute changes; work with A+ content; and manage supported FBA inbound planning, packing, placement, transportation, delivery-window and tracking workflows. Inspect available order-related buyer-contact actions, prepare eligible messages, including product-customization questions, and send permitted review and seller-feedback requests. Create, inspect, update or deactivate Amazon buyer auto-response rules with exact text and triggers.

Work by conversation in ChatGPT, investigate and build repeatable workflows in Codex, or combine the plugin with separately available and authorized Codex screen-control tools to inspect visible pages and carry out permitted tasks. Screen control is a host capability, not bundled with this plugin. Use the combination to understand evidence, diagnose issues, prepare a fix and verify the result.

You stay in control: existing read connections remain read-only; management needs authorization and approval of the specific proposal. Capabilities depend on Amazon permissions, marketplace and eligibility. Buyer communication covers supported order-related actions, not a full inbox. Customer order cancellation, refunds, Vendor and Amazon Ads management are outside this plugin. Net proceeds are not net profit; some reports take time to prepare. No sales, ranking or account-recovery result is guaranteed.

Independent product by NAVINES ISRAEL LTD, not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon or OpenAI.

review.commerce_description: NAVINES IQ offers initial free access and paid Seller and Advertising Intelligence service access on its website. The plugin uses an authorized account and does not sell subscriptions or process checkout. Approved FBA placement or transportation actions may incur Amazon charges. The isolated reviewer demo needs no payment or Amazon account and simulates changes without contacting buyers.

positive.description: Use the dedicated preconfigured reviewer demo after password sign-in and OAuth consent. No email code, Amazon connection or setup is required.
positive.prompt: Check my seller connection and marketplaces, explain which data is available, and tell me whether this is live or sample data.
positive.expected_behavior: All three tools return labeled synthetic sample data. Identify NAVINES IQ OpenAI Demo, US marketplace ATVPDKIKX0DER and USD, realAmazonConnected=false, plus scope limitations. Do not ask the reviewer to connect Amazon or describe these examples as real sales.

positive.description: Continue with the returned US marketplace. Use September 1-7, 2026 UTC: inclusive 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z, exclusive 2026-09-08T00:00:00Z. Inspect only an order ID actually returned.
positive.prompt: For September 1-7, 2026, show total sales, units and order counts, compare the aggregate sales views, list available orders, and inspect one order's items.
positive.expected_behavior: Use interval=2026-09-01T00:00:00Z--2026-09-08T00:00:00Z with granularity=Total for SellingPartnerInsights; matching startTime/endTime and createdAfter/createdBefore where supported. Show sample USD 1000 sales, 50 units and 40 orders. Inspect returned DEMO-ORDER-001: two units and USD 40. Explain that the single order is an illustrative excerpt, not the complete 40-order ledger. No buyer PII.

positive.description: Same demo, US marketplace and fixed September 1-7, 2026 period. Discover SKU SAMPLE-BOTTLE and ASIN DEMOASIN01 from returned data. Product metadata is not a full sales ledger.
positive.prompt: Compare my financial snapshot and detailed finances, explain fees and net proceeds, then discover listing issues and inspect the affected item's listing, product details and current price.
positive.tools_triggered: getAmazonFinancialSnapshot, getAmazonFinancialPerformance, getAmazonListingsAndIssues, getAmazonProductListingAnalysis, getAmazonProductPerformance, getAmazonPricingVisibility
positive.expected_behavior: Use postedAfter/postedBefore for the fixed sample dates. Show USD 1000 sales minus USD 180 fees and USD 60 refunds = USD 760 net proceeds, explicitly not net profit. Get the warning listing, inspect its returned SKU, then returned ASIN and pricing with itemType=Asin. Sample price is USD 20; the sample packaging attribute warning is advisory only. Do not claim costs or audited profit are available or any edit occurred.

positive.description: Same demo and fixed September 1-7, 2026 UTC period. Use each tool's date parameter names and bounded views, including inventory summary, shipped inbound plans, ledger detail, aged inventory and reimbursements.
positive.prompt: Review my stock quantities, shipped inbound plans, FBA inventory, inventory movements, aged stock, reimbursements and seller-performance indicators. Explain the limitations.
positive.tools_triggered: getAmazonInventoryVisibility, getAmazonFbaVisibility, getAmazonFbaInventoryIntelligence, getAmazonInventoryMovements, getAmazonStorageAndAgedInventory, getAmazonReturnsAndReimbursements, getAmazonSellerPerformance
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned marketplace and September 1 through exclusive September 8 timestamps where supported; getAmazonFbaVisibility accepts status=SHIPPED without date arguments. Identify sample bottle quantities 8 fulfillable, 20 inbound and 2 reserved; mug aged stock of 50 units in 181-270 days; one USD 20 reimbursement. Report sample performance as selected indicators, not complete Account Health. Clearly label synthetic data and distinguish pending-report behavior on live accounts.

positive.description: Same demo and September 1-7, 2026 UTC. Authorization for analytical report reads does not authorize seller resource edits.
positive.prompt: Check the marketplace-level priorities, then investigate my seller business for September 1-7, 2026 and identify the most important stock risk with supporting evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Keep the narrow participation-based priorities separate from the broader investigation. Explain the sample bottle risk from 8 fulfillable units and 30 units sold in seven days: about 1.87 days of cover. Inbound 20 units are not current sellable stock. State source, fixed sample period and USD, label any estimate, and recommend verification without claiming a shipment, inventory, listing or order change.

positive.description: Dedicated isolated reviewer fixture. Product SAMPLE-BOTTLE uses ASIN DEMOASIN01, FNSKU X00DEMO001, UPC 012345678905 or EAN 0012345678905.
positive.prompt: What is the current price for SAMPLE-BOTTLE? Then find the same sample product using barcode 0012345678905.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve both identifiers in the US fixture to SAMPLE-BOTTLE and show the synthetic seller price USD 20 with sample_data=true. Do not claim this is a live Amazon price. Unsupported fixture identifiers return no match rather than invented products.

positive.description: Dedicated isolated reviewer account with Seller management scope. No real buyer contact.
positive.prompt: Create a sample automatic response for US ASIN B07F6271HL, SHIPPING, POST_ORDER, with text Thank you. We will review your order question. Show the rule and wait for my approval. Then read it back and prepare deactivation.
positive.expected_behavior: Creation preview does not activate anything. After specific user approval simulate ACTIVE and return an automationId. Read back the same stored text and triggers. Prepare deactivation preserving all store entries and await a separate approval; approved deactivation reads back DEACTIVATED. All results are sample_data=true and no Amazon account or buyer is affected.

positive.description: Use the existing isolated reviewer account and approve Seller management access during OAuth. US marketplace ATVPDKIKX0DER. Read SAMPLE-BOTTLE first; changes affect only synthetic fixture storage.
positive.prompt: Check my management access and the sample bottle listing. Prepare a change of merchant-fulfilled quantity to 12. Show what will change and wait for my approval. After I approve, apply it and read it back.
positive.expected_behavior: All results must be labeled sample_data=true. First amazonPatchListingsItem call uses marketplaceId=ATVPDKIKX0DER, request.path.sku=SAMPLE-BOTTLE, body.productType=BOTTLE and a replace patch to /attributes/fulfillment_availability with DEFAULT quantity 12. The preview is pending and no change occurs. After explicit approval, repeat the identical request with the returned previewId and confirmation. The simulation completes, a repeated execution does not dispatch again, and amazonGetListingsItem reads quantity 12.

positive.description: Same isolated sample account with management authorization. Use DEMO-ORDER-001 from the reporting sample. Do not contact any real buyer.
positive.prompt: For the sample order, check the available contact actions and preferred language. Prepare a brief message asking the buyer to confirm their order details. Show it before sending, and send only after I approve.
positive.expected_behavior: Read eligible actions and preferred locale en-US; no inbox or message-history claim. Prepare English text limited to order completion. The first write-tool call returns a pending sample preview including the text and target order. After user approval only, the same exact payload and preview confirmation complete a simulated send, with no real buyer contact.

positive.description: Same isolated sample account. Discover the synthetic inbound plan and placement option from tool results; do not invent identifiers.
positive.prompt: Show my sample inbound plan and placement options, including charges. Prepare confirmation of the available option and wait. If I approve, confirm it and check the operation status.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned 38-character plan and option IDs, marketplace ATVPDKIKX0DER. Preview shows the selected option and sample USD 8 placement fee. No confirmation before explicit approval. Approved simulated confirmation returns an operationId that passes the status tool schema; status is synthetic SUCCESS. Never claim an actual shipment or charge occurred.

positive.description: Same isolated sample account. US marketplace and DEMO-ORDER-001. Eligibility is read before a request; this is not a general buyer-marketing tool.
positive.prompt: Check whether a review and seller-feedback request is available for the sample order. Explain the action, prepare it for my approval, and then send the approved request.
positive.expected_behavior: Eligibility is checked, the first request creates a pending synthetic preview, and only an explicit approval permits simulated submission with the exact same order and marketplace. Do not compose incentives or claim real reviews were obtained.

negative.description: Customer order cancellation and refunds are not implemented; a complete buyer inbox is not provided. Do not invoke listing deletion or FBA cancellation as a substitute, or claim inbox access or a refund. Explain the supported alternatives.
negative.prompt: Read every conversation in my buyer inbox, cancel my latest customer order and refund the buyer now.

negative.description: Amazon Ads data is outside Seller Insights and requires a separate authorized connection. Do not invoke seller tools as a substitute or infer advertising metrics from seller sales.
negative.prompt: Show my advertising campaigns' spend, search terms, ACOS and ROAS, then pause the weakest campaign.

negative.description: Other sellers' private data, credentials and restricted buyer PII are outside scope. Do not perform unauthorized lookups, accept another account's token, or disclose account existence.

prompts: Investigate my Amazon seller business and prioritize the most important issues with evidence.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.19.0 retains the 23 existing seller reporting tools and adds 79 tools/helpers: 37 additional API reads, 40 explicit preview-and-approval mutations and two access/status helpers. Adds product-price resolution by ASIN, SKU, FNSKU, UPC, EAN, GTIN, ISBN, JAN and MINSAN, fallback seller offer prices and rate-limit-aware reads. Adds listings, pricing and merchant-fulfilled stock updates, A+ content, FBA inbound workflows, eligible buyer messages, automatic buyer-response rules and review requests. New write scope requires separate consent; legacy grants remain read-only. Adds user-bound expiring previews, atomic dispatch, unknown-outcome protection, boolean annotations and isolated synthetic review fixtures. Expands English/Hebrew Amazon seller and Codex discovery terms; clarifies separately authorized host screen-control workflows. Amazon role approval and seller eligibility still govern availability.
